clauses.clause: APC cannot wedge off-road before the bridge; no giant flat arrow over it; HUD bar matches durability.
clauses.note: Both physical normal-damage WASD routes contact and escape all three tent/bus/checkpoint obstacles using ordinary reverse/steering. Escape speeds5.8784–5.9231m/s, durability980/970/930low and980/970/910high. Twelve personally reviewed escaped-view frames at both tiers and zoom0.5/1.5 show matching HUD text and bar fill, and no giant flat world arrow. Dense input/event ledgers cover each recovery; no relocation, cheats or route skip.
